title: An Application of Geometric Riemannian Pricing Algorithm for Valuing Catastrophe Bonds in Incomplete Markets: Market-Consistent Financial Entropy and the Split of Frequency and Severity Risk Premia
abstract: arXiv:2610.37171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a framework for pricing catastrophe (CAT) bonds in incomplete markets through Riemannian geometric optimization of financial entropy. We formulate pricing-measure selection as a maximum financial entropy problem on a finite-dimensional manifold of equivalent measures, parameterized by the non-hedgeable market prices of catastrophe frequency and severity risk, with discounting fixed by the default-free term structure. Since unconstrained entropy maximization recovers the physical measure, we incorporate observed secondary-market spreads, both pooled and date by date. For a compound Poisson-generalized Pareto loss model with Wang distortion, we derive closed-form expressions for financial entropy and the Riemannian metric. translated_title: 几何黎曼定价算法在不完全市场中巨灾债券估值的应用：市场一致金融熵与频率和严重性风险溢价的分解
translated_abstract: 本文提出一个通过金融熵的黎曼几何优化来为不完全市场中的巨灾（CAT）债券定价的框架。我们将定价测度的选择表述为在等价测度的有限维流形上的最大金融熵问题，该流形由不可对冲的巨灾频率风险和严重性风险的市场价格参数化，贴现由无违约期限结构固定。由于无约束的熵最大化会恢复物理测度，我们纳入了观察到的二级市场利差，包括汇总方式和逐日方式。对于具有Wang扭曲的复合泊松-广义帕累托损失模型，我们推导出了金融熵和黎曼度量的闭式表达式。我们证明巨灾债券价格主要通过风险中性触发强度依赖于频率和严重性溢价，使得这两个溢价无法仅从市场数据中识别；熵准则……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于黎曼几何优化金融熵的巨灾债券定价框架，在完全市场中通过纳入二级市场利差实现市场一致的定价，并证明频率与严重性风险溢价仅通过风险中性触发强度影响价格，因而无法仅凭市场数据加以区分识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a catastrophe bond pricing framework based on Riemannian geometric optimization of financial entropy for incomplete markets, achieving market-consistent pricing by incorporating observed secondary-market spreads, and shows that frequency and severity risk premia affect prices only through the risk-neutral trigger intensity, making them unidentifiable from market data alone.
